h1: The 5 Best 80V Leaf Blowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five Greenworks 80V leaf blowers, from 770 CFM handhelds to a 750 CFM backpack, with airflow, price tiers and tradeoffs.
summary: The 770 CFM Greenworks 80V is the strongest handheld here. The 750 CFM backpack is the pick for large properties, the 730 CFM model is the value option in the $100 to $200 tier, and the 500 CFM unit is the lightest-duty choice.
intro: Every blower in this list shares the Greenworks 80V name, so the trap is assuming they perform alike. The listed airflow ranges from 500 to 770 CFM, and two of them cost half as much as the rest.
We reviewed five Greenworks 80V blowers and ranked them on the listed specifications: airflow, format and price tier. The listings do not state battery runtime, so we do not compare it.

products.name: Greenworks 80V Electric Leaf Blower (770 CFM)
products.verdict: The highest listed airflow here at 770 CFM, cordless.
products.description:
This Greenworks 80V cordless blower lists 770 CFM, the highest airflow in the group.

It ranks first because no other model here lists more air, and it beats the 730 CFM value model by 40 CFM. The tradeoff is the $200 to $500 tier.

Choose it for big piles. The caveat is that the listing gives no MPH or runtime.
products.idealFor: Large yards with heavy leaf fall.

products.name: Greenworks 80V Backpack Leaf Blower
products.verdict: A 750 CFM backpack format for longer jobs.
products.description:
The backpack model lists 750 CFM in a backpack format, putting the weight on your shoulders.

It ranks second because it trails the 770 CFM handheld by 20 CFM, but the backpack format suits extended cleanup.

It suits large properties. The caveat is the same $200 to $500 tier.

products.name: Greenworks 80V Electric Leaf Blower (730 CFM)
products.description:
This model lists 730 CFM from a cordless 80V handheld, in the $100 to $200 tier.

Third place reflects that it gives up only 40 CFM against the 770 CFM model while costing less.

Buy it for the airflow per dollar. The caveat is the thin listing.
products.idealFor: Value-minded buyers with a big yard.

products.name: Greenworks 80V Electric Leaf Blower (700 CFM)
products.verdict: 700 CFM cordless, but in the higher price tier.
products.description:
This model lists 700 CFM from a cordless 80V design, in the $200 to $500 tier.

It ranks fourth because the 730 CFM model offers more air for a lower tier.

It suits buyers who prefer this model line. The caveat is the poor value against the 730 CFM unit.
products.idealFor: Buyers set on this exact model line.

products.name: Greenworks 80V Electric Leaf Blower (500 CFM)
products.verdict: 500 CFM for small yards in the $100 to $200 tier.
products.description:
This model lists 500 CFM from a cordless 80V handheld, in the $100 to $200 tier.

Bottom spot comes from moving 230 CFM less than the 730 CFM model for a similar price tier.

It suits small yards and patios. The caveat is the lower airflow.

whatMatters.detail: CFM is the volume of air moved, from 500 to 770 here. It decides how fast piles clear. Find the number in the title.
A backpack carries the weight on your shoulders and suits long jobs. Handhelds are lighter for short ones. Check the format.
Greenworks 80V uses its own battery system. Batteries do not cross platforms, so check what you own.
Similar-looking models sit in different tiers. Compare CFM against tier before buying.

finalTake: The 770 CFM Greenworks 80V is the best here for raw airflow. The backpack model suits long jobs, and the 730 CFM unit is the value pick. The 500 CFM model is only for light work.
